_comment: Phase 14.6 -- advisory daily search-planner budgets/intervals. All values here are defaults only; every key has an environment-variable override of the same name (upper-cased) checked first by daily_search_planner.load_planner_config(). Never hard-codes a pass/fail assumption about any provider's real pricing or free-tier size -- these are purely local, user-configurable ceilings.
_comment_14_7: Phase 14.7 -- adaptive per-source query expansion. A source's consolidated (round-1) query is followed by ONE MORE targeted query (combining every still-uncovered/under-covered configured location into one OR'd query) only when coverage is insufficient, up to max_provider_queries_per_source_per_run total queries for that source this run, and never exceeding the Section 6 global budgets above.
_comment_14_8: Phase 14.8 -- actual_job_location is only ever KNOWN when location_taxonomy.py can genuinely parse a city from the search result itself; it is never inferred from the query's own target location. A source whose unique/new/completeness are already sufficient is NOT expanded again merely because some of its jobs have UNKNOWN location -- at most this many additional queries may be triggered by a location gap alone (still bounded by max_provider_queries_per_source_per_run and the global run/day budgets above).
